public_sources.bound_semantics: RFC 7661 defines a non-validated phase where congestion-window state reflects a previous capacity measurement whose current validity is unknown. It constrains use/growth of that preserved state until fresh acknowledged traffic validates it, reacts conservatively to congestion/RTO, and reduces preserved state after a bounded non-validated period.

chat_native_reduction.mapping: Treat inherited estimator state after an epoch rollover as non-validated adaptive state. Keep it shadow-only while fresh current-epoch terminal evidence is collected, analogous only to RFC 7661's validated/non-validated distinction.
chat_native_reduction.probation_rule: For exactly two distinct same-scope current-epoch terminal latency samples, active deadline stays at role-local conservative ceiling12 while shadow SRTT/RTTVAR is updated. After the second sample, activate the refreshed shadow deadline.
chat_native_reduction.invalid_event_rule: Duplicate, stale, scope-mismatched and transport-uncertain observations neither update shadow state nor advance probation.
chat_native_reduction.formula_note: The two-sample count and deadline ceiling are role-local precommitted safety parameters, not RFC 7661 requirements.

control_results.details: Samples [2,2] are admitted under active deadline12. Shadow deadline evolves 3.6875 then3.265625; after the second fresh sample probation completes and active deadline becomes3.265625.

Samples [2,8] are both admitted under deadline12. Shadow deadline evolves3.6875 then10.015625; after the second fresh sample active deadline becomes10.015625 instead of timing out at inherited3.6875 before the latency8 observation can be learned.
After one fresh sample, durable state records probation_remaining=1 plus shadow SRTT/RTTVAR. Restart reconstructs those exact values and does not reactivate inherited state early.
Duplicate latency2, stale latency8 and transport-uncertain latency9 produce zero shadow updates and zero probation progress.

ablation_result.immediate_full_trust: FAIL_AS_INTENDED on abrupt-shift control because inherited/post-probe deadline3.6875 is below next valid latency8
ablation_result.probationary_shadow: PASS fixed stable and abrupt-shift controls and eventually recovers a tighter stable deadline

credit_rule: At most one role-local credit after exact terminal readback; creation alone earns zero credit.
scope_limit: Fixed synthetic latency trace only. RFC 7661 concerns TCP congestion-window validation, not timeout estimators; this result claims only the transferable control principle of marking inherited adaptive state non-validated until fresh evidence supports reuse.
